source: Pew Research Center. 2009. "Faith in Flux: Changes in Religious Affiliation in the U.S."
method: Population is all respondents who left the religion they were raised in (this recontact survey's own design). Top-two-box ("very strong" + "somewhat strong") on q12 (faith strength as a teenager, in their childhood religion) and q13 (faith strength now, in their current religion); each item's own "didn't/don't have religious faith" and don't know/refused excluded from its own denominator. Weighted by the dataset's own `weight` variable.
